steps.say: Open Table is a set of small tabletop games. Two people can play one on a shared screen, and each game can be shown in more than one way.
This game is called Beacon Steps. One marker sits on a path of eight spaces. The players take turns moving it one or two spaces.
Player one moves first. Player one moves the marker two spaces.
The path updates at once. Now it is player two's turn.
Player one moves two spaces again, to five.
Player two moves two spaces, and lands exactly on seven.
Seven is the goal. The game ends, and the screen says who won.
Each way of showing the choices is checked against the original game. The check covers every state the game can reach.
Open Table is for people who want to play together, however they take their turns. Thanks for watching.
